description: This Kotlin source file defines the GatewayDiscovery class responsible for discovering network gateways using various DNS and network service discovery techniques on Android. It manages local and wide-area gateway endpoints, resolving services through mDNS and unicast DNS queries, and maintains observable state flows for the list of gateways and status updates.

classes.name: GatewayDiscovery
classes.description: A class for discovering network gateways via mDNS and DNS over unicast on Android, supporting both local and wide-area domain discovery, and exposing observable flows of gateway endpoints and status text.

methods.name: startLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Starts network service discovery for local gateways using Android NsdManager.

methods.name: stopLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Stops local gateway discovery.

methods.name: startUnicastDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates continuous unicast DNS discovery for wide-area gateways on a background coroutine.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a given NsdServiceInfo to a GatewayEndpoint and updates internal maps.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Updates the observable list of gateways and status text based on current discovery results.

methods.name: buildStatusText
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly status string indicating discovery progress and counts.

methods.name: stableId
methods.description: Constructs a stable identifier for a gateway service based on service name and domain.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Normalizes service or instance names by trimming and normalizing whitespace.

methods.name: txt
methods.description: Extracts a UTF-8 string value from NsdServiceInfo attributes by key.

methods.name: txtInt
methods.description: Parses an integer value from NsdServiceInfo attributes.

methods.name: txtBool
methods.description: Determines boolean attribute values from NsdServiceInfo attributes.

methods.name: refreshUnicast
methods.description: Performs a unicast DNS PTR/SRV/TXT lookup for gateways in a given domain, updating internal maps.

methods.name: decodeInstanceName
methods.description: Decodes the instance name from a FQDN relative to the service type and domain.

methods.name: stripTrailingDot
methods.description: Removes a trailing dot from a FQDN.

methods.name: lookupUnicastMessage
methods.description: Performs a DNS query over the network or caches the answer for a specific name and record type.

methods.name: queryViaSystemDns
methods.description: Sends a DNS query via the system DNS resolver on a specified network.

methods.name: records
methods.description: Extracts a list of DNS records from a DNS message for a given section.

methods.name: keyName
methods.description: Normalizes a hostname or FQDN to lowercase for key lookup.

methods.name: recordsByName
methods.description: Indexes DNS records from a message by normalized name.

methods.name: recordByName
methods.description: Retrieves a DNS record of a specific type by name from a message.

methods.name: resolveHostFromMessage
methods.description: Attempts to resolve an IP host from DNS answer records within a DNS message.

methods.name: preferredDnsNetwork
methods.description: Selects the network to perform DNS queries on, prioritizing VPN transports.

methods.name: createDirectResolver
methods.description: Builds a custom DNS resolver using system DNS servers (e.g., VPN or active network).

methods.name: rawQuery
methods.description: Performs a DNS query as a raw byte array, using the DNS resolver with network context.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Extracts a string value prefixed with a key from TXT DNS records.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Parses an integer value from TXT DNS records.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Determines a boolean value from TXT DNS records.

methods.name: decodeDnsTxtString
methods.description: Decodes a DNS TXT string from ISO-8859-1 bytes to UTF-8.

methods.name: resolveHostUnicast
methods.description: Performs a unicast DNS A/AAAA lookup for a hostname.
